concurrent_load: other acceptance processes may run; not an exclusive host
network_limit: Warm navigation uses multiplexed WebSocket; network, Streamlit queue, serialization and paint residual is included end-to-end and not attributed to pure network.
measurement_clock: Fact/trend timings wait for the new completed page snapshot (conservative upper bound, excludes stale prior DOM). Navigation samples start at the actual captured DOM click event. Automation command-to-settled is separate and includes Playwright actionability waiting. First open starts before page.goto.
